escape_bytes_for_protobuf_text: escape a bytes string for use in a text protocol buffer using CEscape with as_utf8 flag
unescape_cstyle_string_to_bytes: unescape a text string with C-style escape sequences to UTF-8 bytes using CUnescape
escape_unicode_string_utf8: escape a Unicode string preserving non-ASCII characters by calling CEscape with as_utf8 set to True
escape_bytes_ascii_only: escape a bytes string to ASCII-only output by calling CEscape with as_utf8 set to False
review_escape_tables: review the _str_escapes and _byte_escapes lookup tables that map character codes to their escaped representations
